caption:
Your missed-call text-back is half-built.

Most shops send an apology: sorry we missed your call, we'll call you back. That's still a wait. The lead already tried once and got nothing live.

Fix it this week. Put your booking link inside that same text. Two lines: "Sorry we missed you, grab a time here [link]. Text your issue if it's urgent."

Now the lead can book while you're still on the last job. No callback required, no cold trail.
